summary.overallAssessment: Controlled public beta ready; broad launch needs Unicode count correction, consistent dark mode, automated quality gates, canonical configuration, and browser verification.

tools.name: Word Counter
criticalFindings: Character count uses JavaScript UTF-16 string length and overcounts emoji and combined graphemes.
verification: Empty, one word, multiple spaces, multiple lines, punctuation, Hindi, emoji, combining sequence, and 100000-word logic cases executed.
Clipboard and responsive interactions not browser-verified.

tools.name: Character Counter
criticalFindings: Total characters and without spaces count UTF-16 code units, not user-perceived characters.
Without spaces actually removes all Unicode whitespace.
verification: Empty, spaces, line breaks, emoji, Hindi, combining sequence, and large-input logic reviewed/executed.
Interactive controls and viewport behavior not browser-verified.

tools.name: JSON Formatter
criticalFindings: Most business logic is embedded in the Astro page.
Approximate error position depends on JavaScript engine error wording.
verification: Valid object, array, nested, minified, Unicode, empty, and invalid JSON logic cases executed.
Clipboard, file picker, swap, and exact viewport behavior not browser-verified.

tools.name: JSON Builder
criticalFindings: Pure model logic and DOM rendering share one large controller.
Deeply nested mobile behavior is not verified.
verification: Typed model, validation, conversion, import safety, copy/download, and depth code paths inspected.
Interactive builder workflow was not executed in a browser.

tools.name: Base64 Encoder & Decoder
criticalFindings: No production-tested file-size limit or guidance.
Tab semantics do not include arrow navigation or roving tabindex.
FAQ and WebApplication structured data are absent.
verification: Hello World, Hindi plus emoji, Japanese, text Data URL, PNG binary, MIME detection, invalid Base64, and empty-input utilities executed.
Preview, drag/drop, clipboard, download, and object URL lifecycle not browser-verified.

strengths: Typed central tool registry drives homepage cards and search.
Static Astro routes build without warnings.
No network or persistence code handles tool input.
Base64 has a reusable utility and component architecture.
inconsistencies: Dark mode coverage varies materially by tool.
Canonical paths and structured data are inconsistent.
ToolLayout and ToolHeader are only used by Base64.
Related tools range from none to comprehensive.
recommendations: Extract and test text-stat and JSON pure utilities.
Derive available related tools from the registry.
Adopt shared tool shell components opportunistically.

buildResults.details: Astro, Tailwind CSS, and Tailwind Vite integration only.

launchReadiness.recommendation: Controlled beta ready; address critical findings before broad public launch.

limitations: No interactive browser or assistive-technology tests were performed.
Exact responsive widths and dark-mode appearance were assessed from code only.
No lint, strict type-check, or automated test scripts are configured.
Clipboard permissions, downloads, drag/drop, dialogs, and object URL cleanup were not browser-executed.
Canonical tags cannot be verified in production because Astro.site is not configured.
